text:
maria_ops: Heads up — AdeptLogistics sent a partial tranche: 40x H100, 10x H200 arrived. Depot reported 2 DOA units and customs flagged 3 cartons for paperwork. anyone on customs/ops?

devon_sourcing: who is the vendor rep handling the RMA?

adele_vendor: @devon_sourcing hi — Adele from AdeptLogistics. Confirm partial DOA: S/N H100-87321, H200-44211. We can overnight replacements via AWB 123-4567890 but need Redwood to accept credit terms. Proposal: 60-day credit for replacements + freight, or we expedite and bill freight to RMA (vendor-paid or credited).

maria_ops: 60-day credit is fine only if Adept covers customs brokerage and insurance for replacements. can you share the manifest + commercial invoice now? need HS codes to clear.

adele_vendor: sending now to procurement@redwood.com and ops@redwood.com. Quick excerpt: HS 8471.80, BOL RB-7890, declared value $45,000/unit. AWB: 123-4567890.

devon_sourcing: noted on value. if vendor wants credit instead of immediate replace, we'll require certificate of destruction or return authorization for DOA units. also proposing 1.5% tranche discount because DOA rate > 1.2% on this shipment.

maria_ops: parity replacement policy: H100->H100, H200->H200. if parity not in stock, vendor must propose equivalent performance swap.

logistics-bot: RMA ticket created RMA-2026-04 by @adele_vendor. Estimated replacement ETA: 48h after manifest confirmation.

tara_customs: @adele_vendor please ensure commercial invoice includes importer EIN 12-3456789 and detailed packing list scanned. missing docs cause EU holds of 24-72h.

adele_vendor: will upload docs in 30m and send scanned packing list to @tara_customs.

maria_ops: also need inspection photos for the two DOA units and a signed DOA form. if vendor opts for credit, we need a DOA disposition form + certificate of destruction.

adele_vendor: understood. quick operational note: if EU customs holds, Adept can split the remaining available units across EU and US shipments to avoid capacity hole. propose 20 H100 -> EU DC, 20 H100 -> US, H200s split by demand.

devon_sourcing: sounds reasonable. approving provisional split. confirm vendor will cover brokerage + insurance for replacements and accept 60-day credit on replacement value + apply 1.5% discount to this tranche.

adele_vendor: Adept confirms will cover brokerage and insurance for replacements and apply 1.5% discount credit on next invoice. AWB tracking: https://tracking.example/123-4567890

maria_ops: perfect. @nate_infra can you check warm-spare pool and rebalancing timeline? we need to avoid user-facing capacity regression.

nate_infra: on it. warm spare pool can cover ~12 units for 6hrs; otherwise we'll cold-provision new nodes, ~3h for infra + scheduling.

maria_ops: thanks — I'll update the ops board and close the loop once docs are in. closing notes: RMA-2026-04 logged; Adept to send DOA photos and signed forms, Adept covers brokerage/insurance, 60-day credit approved, 1.5% discount to be applied.

adele_vendor: docs uploaded and emailed. will book replacements once DOA forms are returned. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
